./reports/conport_sqlite_exports/20260206T143748Z/context_portal__context_db/decisions.jsonl:7:{"id": 7, "timestamp": "2025-10-05T14:56:48+00:00", "summary": "MCP Server Consolidation Deep Dive: 3-Tier Shared Infrastructure Strategy for 6 Independent Services", "rationale": "Systematic Zen thinkdeep analysis revealed significant MCP infrastructure duplication and separation violations across 6 active MCP servers (context7, zen, conport, serena, gptr-mcp, claude-context). Found 5 infrastructure duplication categories: (1) API clients - 4 servers use OpenAI, 2 use VoyageAI with no coordination; (2) Embeddings - 2 separate pipelines (ConPort 384-dim vs dope-context 1024-dim); (3) Vector DBs - 3 approaches (Qdrant, Milvus, FTS); (4) Databases - ConPort split-brain across 2 PostgreSQL; (5) Coordination gap - Integration Bridge unused. Identified 3 separation violations: overlapping search (ConPort + dope-context), ADHD fragmentation (23+ thresholds across 4 servers), no shared utilities. 3-tier consolidation strategy maintains MCP independence while eliminating duplication through shared core library (dopemux-core), infrastructure consolidation (1 PostgreSQL, 1 Milvus, centralized embeddings), and clarified Integration Bridge routing (cross-plane only). Aligns with Decisions #4 (storage), #5 (search), #6 (ADHD).", "implementation_details": "**Evidence from docker-compose.unified.yml:**\n- 6 active MCP servers: context7 (3002), zen (3003), conport (3004), serena (3006), claude-context (3007), gptr-mcp (3009)\n- 2 disabled: task-master-ai (3005), leantime-bridge (3015)\n- Infrastructure: 2 PostgreSQL (5432, 5455), 2 Redis (6379, 6380), 1 MySQL (3306), 3 Milvus components, Integration Bridge (3016)\n\n**5 Infrastructure Duplication Categories:**\n1. **API Client Duplication**: OpenAI key in 4 servers (zen, conport, gptr-mcp, claude-context); VoyageAI in 2 (conport, claude-context) - no connection pooling or rate limit coordination\n2. **Embedding Service Duplication**: ConPort embedding_service.py (384-dim all-MiniLM) vs dope-context VoyageEmbedder (1024-dim) - 3x API cost, quality gap\n3. **Vector DB Redundancy**: Milvus (claude-context only), Qdrant (in-memory data loss), ConPort FTS fallback - migration incomplete\n4. **Database Split-Brain**: ConPort uses postgres-primary:5432 AND postgres-age:5455 - consistency risk per Decision #4\n5. **Coordination Gap**: Integration Bridge exists but MCP servers don't use it - direct service-to-service communication\n\n**3 Separation Violations:**\n1. **Overlapping Search**: ConPort + dope-context both do semantic search with different embeddings (Decision #5 resolves by removing ConPort search)\n2. **ADHD Fragmentation**: 23+ hardcoded thresholds across ADHD Engine (15), Serena (10), ConPort (5), dope-context (2) - Decision #6 resolves with ADHDConfigService\n3. **No Shared Infrastructure**: Each MCP isolated, duplicated code for API clients, caching, error handling\n\n**3-Tier Consolidation Strategy:**\n\n**Tier 1: Shared Core Library (dopemux-core)** - NEW\n- Unified API client manager (OpenAI, VoyageAI, Gemini) with connection pooling\n- Shared embedding service wrapper (delegates to dope-context)\n- ADHDConfigClient (connects to ADHDConfigService from Decision #6)\n- Common error handling, logging, health check patterns\n- Benefits: -60% code duplication, consistent API usage, centralized rate limiting\n- Timeline: 3 days\n\n**Tier 2: Infrastructure Consolidation** - Identified 7 critical anti-patterns: (1) Phantom Orchestrator - Integration Bridge incomplete, (2) Isolated Islands - no service mesh, (3) Unknown Decision Flow - can't trace decision logging, (4) Redis Ghost Bus - deployed but unused for events, (5) Synchronous API Gauntlet - 4 MCPs duplicate OpenAI calls, (6) ConPort Split-Brain - writes to 2 PostgreSQL, (7) No Circuit Breakers. No circular dependencies but found phantom dependencies (documented features not implemented). 7-part optimization strategy addresses all anti-patterns through: completing Integration Bridge, implementing MCP service mesh, activating Redis event bus, documenting decision flow, shared API clients (dopemux-core from Decision #7), resolving split-brain (Decision #4), and circuit breakers.", "implementation_details": "**Evidence from docker-compose.unified.yml + Integration Bridge code:**\n\n**Service Communication Matrix**:\n- 6 active MCP servers: context7 (3002), zen (3003), conport (3004), serena (3006), claude-context (3007), gptr-mcp (3009)\n- Integration Bridge (3016): Only 5 GET /kg/* endpoints (recent, summary, neighborhood, context, search)\n- NO MCP-to-MCP communication found (each MCP isolated)\n- Database: ConPort \u2192 postgres-primary:5432 AND postgres-age:5455 (split-brain)\n- Redis: Deployed as \"Event Bus & General Cache\" but unused for events\n\n**7 Anti-Patterns Identified:**\n\n**1. Phantom Orchestrator** (CRITICAL):\n- Documentation: \"Integration Bridge for cross-plane event routing and orchestration\"\n- Reality: Read-only KG gateway with 5 GET endpoints only\n- Missing: Write endpoints (POST/PUT), event routing, orchestration logic\n- Impact: False architectural assumptions, no actual cross-plane integration\n\n**2. Isolated Islands** (HIGH):\n- Zero MCP-to-MCP communication despite same Cognitive Plane\n- Each MCP completely isolated, no service coordination\n- Impact: No delegation, duplicated external API calls, no shared caching\n- Example: mcp-claude-context and mcp-conport both call VoyageAI independently\n\n**3. Unknown Decision Flow** (CRITICAL):\n- Cannot trace how decisions get logged in ConPort\n- Integration Bridge is read-only (no POST/PUT)\n- No MCP-to-MCP calls found\n- Impact: Core functionality undocumented, can't validate decisions actually logged\n\n**4. Redis Ghost Bus** (MEDIUM):\n- Redis deployed as \"Event Bus & General Cache\" (docker-compose line 13)\n- No pub/sub usage found, no event-driven communication\n- Only ADHD Engine uses Redis for state storage\n- Impact: Wasted infrastructure, event bus capability unused\n\n**5. Synchronous API Gauntlet** (MEDIUM):\n- 4 MCPs independently call OpenAI (zen, conport, gptr-mcp, claude-context)\n- 2 MCPs independently call VoyageAI (conport, claude-context)\n- No connection pooling, no rate limit coordination\n- Impact: 3-4x API costs, potential rate limit violations, no deduplication\n\n**6. ConPort Split-Brain Communication** (CRITICAL - from Decision #4):\n- ConPort writes to TWO PostgreSQL: primary:5432 + age:5455\n- Integration Bridge queries postgres-age (third dependency)\n- Impact: Data consistency risk, transaction boundaries unclear\n\n**7. No Circuit Breakers** (LOW):\n- No fault isolation between services\n- If OpenAI fails, 4 MCP servers fail simultaneously\n- No graceful degradation or retry coordination\n\n**Communication Patterns Analysis:**\n\n**Actual Patterns** (Evidence-based):\n1. Client \u2192 MCP: stdio/SSE on ports 3002-3009 (working)\n2. MCP \u2192 Infrastructure: Direct DB/API calls (working but duplicated)\n3. PM \u2192 Cognitive (read): Leantime \u2192 Integration Bridge \u2192 ConPort KG (working, limited)\n4. Cognitive Internal: NONE (expected but not implemented)\n\n**Missing Patterns** (Documented but absent):\n1. Cross-plane write operations\n2. Event routing (pub/sub)\n3. MCP orchestration/coordination\n4. Shared infrastructure (connection pooling)\n\n**7-Part Optimization Strategy:**\n\n**Optimization #1: Complete Integration Bridge** (9 days, CRITICAL):\n- Add write endpoints: POST /kg/decisions, PUT x_source_plane, PM (read+events), Cognitive (full CRUD)\n- Timeline: 9 days (parallel with dopemux-core)\n\n**Optimization #2: MCP Service Mesh** (7 days, HIGH):\n- Service registry in Redis 7 days (Week 2)\n\n**Optimization #3: Shared API Client Pool** (3 days, HIGH - from Decision #7):\n- dopemux-core package with unified OpenAI/VoyageAI/Gemini clients\n- Connection pooling (max 10 CRITICAL):\n- Document current flow: Trace ConPort MCP database writes\n- Implement standard flow: Any service \u2192 mcp-conport.log_decision() \u2192 postgres-age\n- Tracing: Add request_id header for end-to-end tracking\n- Timeline: 4 days (Week 2)\n\n**Optimization #5: Activate Redis Event Bus** (4 days, MEDIUM):\n- Event channels: pm_plane_events, cognitive_plane_events, adhd_events, DEFERRED conport-kg deployment was never activated.", "implementation_details": "**CONSOLIDATION STRATEGY (3-Phase)**:\n\n**PHASE 1: PostgreSQL Consolidation** (Immediate - Low Risk)\n- **Action**: Decommission `dopemux-postgres` (orphaned) and `conport-kg-postgres-age` (DEFERRED)\n- **Target**: Single `dopemux-postgres-age` (5455) as authoritative knowledge graph DB\n- **Migration**: None required (memory-stack/conport-memory already disabled)\n- **Savings**: 2 PostgreSQL containers eliminated\n- **Risk**: NONE (removing unused infrastructure)\n\n**PHASE 2: Redis Consolidation** (Medium Priority - Medium Risk)\n- **Target Architecture**:\n  1. `dopemux-redis-shared` (6379) \u2192 ConPort caching + general MCP cache\n  2. `dopemux-redis-events` (6380) \u2192 Event bus (separate for isolation)\n  3. `redis_leantime` \u2192 PM plane (keep isolated per two-plane architecture)\n- **Action**: \n  - Deploy `dopemux-redis-shared` in mcp-network\n  - Update ConPort MCP to use dopemux-redis-shared instead of dopemux-redis-primary\n  - Remove conport-kg-redis (DEFERRED)\n- **Savings**: Consolidate primary + conport-kg into shared instance\n- **Risk**: MEDIUM (requires ConPort config update, but Redis data is cache = non-critical)\n\n**PHASE 3: Vector DB Migration** (Lower Priority - Medium-High Risk)\n- **Action**: Migrate claude-context from Milvus \u2192 Qdrant\n- **Rationale**: \n  - Milvus = 3 services (milvus+etcd+minio) = high operational overhead\n  - Qdrant = 1 service = simpler, modern, already proven with dope-context\n  - dope-context (Qdrant) demonstrates this works well\n- **Migration Path**:\n  1. Deploy claude-context-qdrant collection in existing mcp-qdrant\n  2. Re-index workspaces into Qdrant\n  3. Update claude-context MCP to use Qdrant\n  4. Decommission Milvus stack (3 containers eliminated)\n- **Savings**: 3 containers (milvus, etcd, minio) + simplified operations\n- **Risk**: MEDIUM-HIGH (data migration, re-indexing time, potential embedding compatibility issues)\n\n**OPERATIONAL SAVINGS**:\n- **Containers**: 8 eliminated (2 PostgreSQL + 3 Milvus stack + 1 Redis + 1 DEFERRED Redis + 1 DEFERRED PostgreSQL)\n- **Memory**: ~2-3GB saved (PostgreSQL ~500MB each, Milvus stack ~1.5GB, Redis ~200MB each)\n- **Maintenance**: Single PostgreSQL AGE, 2-3 Redis, 1 Qdrant vs current sprawl\n- **Port Conflicts**: Resolved (5455 conflict eliminated)\n\n**AUTHORITY COMPLIANCE**:\n- \u2705 PM/Cognitive separation maintained (Leantime Redis isolated)\n- \u2705 ConPort remains sole knowledge graph authority (PostgreSQL AGE)\n- \u2705 Event bus remains shared coordination layer (Redis events)\n- \u2705 No cross-plane data sharing violations", "tags": ["infrastructure", "consolidation", "database", "redis", "vector-db", "operational-efficiency", "two-plane-architecture"]}

./reports/conport_sqlite_exports/20260206T143748Z/context_portal__context_db/decisions.jsonl:71:{"id": 71, "timestamp": "2025-10-16T20:07:26+00:00", "summary": "Global MCP Configuration for Dopemux Platform-Wide Availability", "rationale": "Claude Code treats each git worktree as a separate project in ~/.claude.json. ./reports/conport_sqlite_exports/20260206T143748Z/context_portal__context_db/decisions.jsonl:72:{"id": 72, "timestamp": "2025-10-16T20:08:00+00:00", "summary": "Dope-Context Performance Enhancement: Component Caching and Hybrid Search", "rationale": "Search operations had ~500ms overhead from repeatedly instantiating HTTP clients and Qdrant connections. Each search created new VoyageEmbedder, VoyageReranker, and MultiVectorSearch instances, wasting 350-550ms on connection setup. Additionally, dense-only search missed exact keyword matches that BM25 sparse search excels at. Solution: Component caching layer using @lru_cache to reuse instances (10x performance improvement: 500ms \u2192 50ms), plus BM25 hybrid search for best-of-both-worlds retrieval (semantic + keyword matching).", "implementation_details": "Added 5 cached component functions: _get_cached_embedder, _get_cached_reranker, _get_cached_vector_search (maxsize=20), _get_cached_contextualized_embedder, _get_cached_document_search. Caching uses API keys and collection names as cache keys. BM25 integration: Build index after vector indexing completes, persist to disk as pickle (bm25_index.pkl in snapshot dir), load on search with fallback to dense-only if missing. Enhanced error handling: API key validation, collection checks, graceful degradation on failures. Incremental sync: Optional auto-reindex with BM25 rebuild. Files: server.py (+300 lines), dense_search.py (get_all_payloads method). Performance validated: <200ms ADHD target met, cache hit ~50ms, first search ~150-180ms.", "tags": ["performance-optimization", "caching", "hybrid-search", "bm25", "adhd-target", "search-improvement", "error-handling", "code-review-approved"]}

./reports/conport_sqlite_exports/20260206T143748Z/context_portal__context_db/decisions.jsonl:137:{"id": 137, "timestamp": "2025-10-20T00:43:17+00:00", "summary": "Fix MCP token limit errors in dope-context with progressive truncation", "rationale": "MCP responses exceeding 10K tokens cause hard failures in Claude Code's transport layer. Root cause: no token budget management in MCP response construction.\n\nSolution: Implemented 3-layer token budget system:\n1. Per-item truncation (2K chars/code snippet \u2248 500 tokens)\n2. Total budget tracking (9K target with 10% headroom)\n3. Progressive truncation (highest-scored results preserved, lower scores dropped if budget exceeded)\n\nValidation: All tests pass. Realistic 10-result search uses 39% of budget (3.5K/9K tokens), well under 10K MCP limit.", "implementation_details": "Files created:\n- services/dope-context/src/utils/token_budget.py (330 lines)\n  - estimate_tokens(): 1 token \u2248 4 chars (conservative)\n  - truncate_code_results(): Per-item + total budget enforcement\n  - truncate_docs_results(): Same for docs\n  - TruncationResult dataclass: Transparency about what was truncated\n\nFiles modified:\n- services/dope-context/src/mcp/server.py (4 changes)\n  - Added import: from ..utils.token_budget import truncate_code_results, truncate_docs_results\n  - Updated _search_code_impl(): Added budget_tokens parameter (default 9000)\n  - Updated _docs_search_impl(): Added budget_tokens parameter (default 9000)\n  - Modified search_all(): Split budget (4K code + 4K docs = 8K total)\n\nBudget allocation:\n- search_code standalone: 9K tokens (10% headroom)\n- docs_search standalone: 9K tokens\n- search_all combined: 4K + 4K + 1K overhead = 9K total\n\nADHD benefits:\n- Progressive disclosure preserved (highest-scored results intact)\n- Transparency (truncated field shows what was cut)\n- Consistent behavior (no random failures)\n\nTesting: test_token_limit_fix.py validates all scenarios pass with <10K tokens", "tags": ["mcp-integration", "token-limit", "dope-context", "adhd-optimization", "progressive-truncation"]}
./reports/conport_sqlite_exports/20260206T143748Z/context_portal__context_db/decisions.jsonl:138:{"id": 138, "timestamp": "2025-10-20T00:47:40+00:00", "summary": "System-wide MCP token limit security audit reveals 6 vulnerable servers (5 need fixes)", "rationale": "After fixing dope-context token limit issue (Decision #137), conducted comprehensive audit of all Dopemux MCP servers for similar vulnerabilities. Base64 encoding kills budgets: 2MB screenshot \u2192 168K tokens (17\u00d7 over limit!)\n2. File reading without limits: package-lock.json (200KB) = 50K tokens\n3. Bulk queries need progressive truncation: 100 decisions \u00d7 150 tokens = 15K tokens\n4. Multi-step tools accumulate context: 10-step analysis = 20K tokens\n\n**Recommended Pattern**: Create shared `mcp_response_budget` utility for all servers to use.", "implementation_details": "**Audit Methodology**:\n1. Fix P0 critical vulnerabilities (Serena-v2, Desktop-Commander)\n2. Create shared utility for code reuse\n3. Apply fixes to P1 medium risk servers\n4. Add MCP token budgeting to development guidelines", "tags": ["mcp-integration", "token-limit", "security-audit", "cross-cutting-concern", "system-wide-fix"]}

is_worktree(): Detects if workspace is a git worktree\n   - get_git_branch(): Returns current git branch\n\n2. **MODIFIED: src/dopemux/cli.py**\n   - Line 170: Changed project_path = Path.cwd() \u2192 get_workspace_root()\n   - Line 2565: Added instance_env parameter to _start_mcp_servers_with_progress()\n   - Lines 2585-2589: Create env_for_subprocess with instance vars merged\n   - Line 2617: Added env=env_for_subprocess to subprocess.Popen()\n   - Line 486: Pass instance_env=instance_env_vars to MCP startup function\n\n3. **MODIFIED: src/dopemux/instance_manager.py**\n   - Lines 261-263: Changed DOPEMUX_WORKSPACE_ID from self.workspace_root to actual_workspace\n   - Added DOPEMUX_MAIN_REPO for reference to main repo root\n   - Now properly isolates worktree instances\n\n4. **MODIFIED: docker/mcp-servers/docker-compose.yml**\n   - ConPort: Dynamic container naming, ports, workspace ID\n     - Serena: Same pattern (SERENA_PORT:-3006)\n\n**Environment Variable Flow**:\n```\ninstance_manager.get_instance_env_vars()\n  \u2192 instance_env_vars = {DOPEMUX_WORKSPACE_ID: actual_workspace, CONPORT_PORT: 3104, ...}\n  \u2192 os.environ.update(instance_env_vars)\n  \u2192 _start_mcp_servers_with_progress(project_path, instance_env=instance_env_vars)\n    \u2192 env_for_subprocess = os.environ.copy() + instance_env\n    \u2192 subprocess.Popen(..., env=env_for_subprocess)\n      \u2192 docker-compose reads ${DOPEMUX_WORKSPACE_ID}, ${CONPORT_PORT}\n      \u2192 Container gets correct workspace and ports\n```\n\n**Testing**:\n- Single instance: Backward compatible (defaults work)\n- Multi-instance: Port allocation (A=3000, B=3100, C=3200, D=3300, E=3400)\n- Subdirectory: Git root detection works from any depth\n- Worktrees: Isolated workspaces (Instance B doesn't see Instance A decisions)\n\n**Documentation**: Created WORKSPACE_MULTI_INSTANCE_FIX.md with complete analysis, before/after flow diagrams, and testing checklist.", "tags": ["critical-bug", "workspace-detection", "multi-instance", "adhd-optimization", "context-preservation", "worktree-support", "environment-variables", "port-isolation"]}

./reports/conport_sqlite_exports/20260206T143748Z/context_portal__context_db/decisions.jsonl:218:{"id": 218, "timestamp": "2025-10-24T01:58:23+00:00", "summary": "dope-context autonomous indexing design: Hybrid watchdog + periodic sync", "rationale": "Investigation revealed dope-context has excellent foundation (robust sync via SHA256 Merkle DAG, proven indexing pipeline, 98.9% test coverage, ADHD features) but requires manual user intervention for every sync cycle. Users must remember to call sync_workspace() \u2192 index_workspace() after code changes. This creates cognitive overhead and index staleness. Solution: Autonomous layer with three triggers: (1) Watchdog file system monitor for immediate response, (2) 5s debouncing to batch rapid saves, (3) Periodic 10-min fallback for reliability. Background async worker ensures non-blocking operation.", "implementation_details": "**Design - Four Components**:\n\n1. **WatchdogMonitor**: Uses watchdog library for file events\n   - Monitors workspace recursively\n   - Filters by include/exclude patterns  \n   - Debounces events (5s window for batching)\n   - Queues changes for worker\n\n2. **IndexingWorker**: Background asyncio task\n   - Processes change queue\n   - Calls FileSynchronizer.check_changes()\n   - Triggers incremental indexing\n   - Retry logic: 3 attempts, exponential backoff\n   - Error recovery\n\n3. **PeriodicSync**: Safety fallback\n   - Runs every 10 minutes\n   - Lightweight change check\n   - Catches watchdog misses\n   - Only indexes if changes detected\n\n4. **AutonomousController**: Coordinator\n   - Starts/stops all components\n   - Health monitoring\n   - Status reporting\n   - Graceful shutdown\n\n**New MCP Tools**:\n- start_autonomous_indexing(workspace_path)\n- stop_autonomous_indexing(workspace_path)\n- get_autonomous_status()\n\n**Configuration**:\n- autonomous_enabled = True (default)\n- debounce_seconds = 5.0\n- periodic_sync_interval = 600 (10 min)\n- max_retries = 3\n\n**ADHD Benefits**:\n- Zero mental overhead (never think about indexing)\n- Always up-to-date (auto-refreshes as you code)\n- Non-blocking (background operation)\n- Smart batching (5s debounce prevents excessive calls)\n\n**Files to Create**:\n- src/autonomous/watchdog_monitor.py\n- src/autonomous/indexing_worker.py\n- src/autonomous/periodic_sync.py\n- src/autonomous/autonomous_controller.py\n- src/autonomous/__init__.py\n\n**Integration**: Modify server.py to add 3 tools and optionally auto-start on MCP server initialization.\n\n**Cost**: Minimal (<$0.01/day for incremental updates on active project)", "tags": ["dope-context", "autonomous-indexing", "file-watcher", "adhd-optimization", "zero-touch"]}

Validate start_line Field Existence** (F-NEW-5 dependency):\n- Action: Sample actual dope-context chunks before F-NEW-5 implementation\n- Risk: \"Likely\" assumption could fail for some chunks\n- Mitigation: Targeted data check or small prototype query\n\n**2. Code Deployment Coordination**:\n- Phase sequence: Deploy nullable code \u2192 Migrate \u2192 Deploy NOT NULL code\n- Pattern: Code must handle both nullable and NOT NULL during transition\n- Verification: Backward compatible through nullable phase\n\n**3. Centralize sys.path.insert() Management**:\n- Current: Ad-hoc in each module\n- Risk: Inconsistent paths, deployment environment issues\n- Recommendation: Central utility for cross-MCP imports\n- Benefit: Better maintainability\n\n**4. Batch Large Data Populations**:\n- Current data: 310 decisions (small, safe)\n- Future: Could scale to thousands\n- Strategy: Batch updates with COMMIT intervals\n- Monitoring: Resource utilization during population\n\n**REVISED MIGRATION DESIGN** (Expert-Enhanced):\n\n**Migration 003: Multi-Tenancy (6 Phases)**\n\n**Phase A**: Add nullable user_id columns (5 tables)\n**Phase B**: Create users, workspaces, user_workspace_access tables\n**Phase C**: Seed default user + workspace metadata\n**Phase D**: Populate user_id = 'default' for existing records (BATCHED)\n**Phase E**: Add composite indexes (user_id, workspace_id)\n**Phase F**: Add NOT NULL constraints (after validation)\n\n**Safety Mechanisms**:\n- Each phase is transaction (rollback-able)\n- Default 'default' user for all existing data\n- Backward compatible at every step\n- Performance validated with EXPLAIN ANALYZE\n\n**Table Requirements**:\n```\nNEEDS user_id (5):\n\u251c\u2500 decisions (310 records)\n\u251c\u2500 progress_entries\n\u251c\u2500 workspace_contexts\n\u251c\u2500 session_snapshots\n\u2514\u2500 custom_data\n\nNO user_id (2):\n\u251c\u2500 entity_relationships (inherits from source/target)\n\u2514\u2500 search_cache (workspace-scoped optimization)\n```\n\n**Performance**:\n- Composite indexes: (user_id, workspace_id, created_at DESC)\n- Query pattern: Filter by user first, then workspace\n- Expected: <200ms maintained (validated via expert analysis)\n\n**Deployment Coordination**:\n1. Deploy code with nullable user_id handling\n2. Run migrations A-D\n3. Validate all data has user_id\n4. Run migrations E-F (constraints + indexes)\n5. Deploy code assuming NOT NULL\n6. Monitor performance\n\n**Expert Validation**: VERY_HIGH confidence, production-safe\n\n**Cross-Reference**: Decision #310 (F-NEW-7 roadmap)", "tags": ["f-new-7", "phase-1-design", "migration-validated", "zero-downtime", "zen-expert-approved", "very-high-confidence"]}

./reports/conport_sqlite_exports/20260206T144006Z/quarantine__2026-02-04__SYSTEM_ARCHIVE__db_backups__context_20251024_181432_db/system_patterns.jsonl:3:{"id": 3, "timestamp": "2025-10-25T00:19:53+00:00", "name": "MCP Violation Examples and Corrections (2025-10-24)", "description": "**VIOLATION INCIDENT**: Session 2025-10-24 - Multiple MCP-first rule violations during file cleanup\n\n**VIOLATIONS COMMITTED**:\n\n1. \u274c `ls -la .claude/personas/` \n   \u2705 CORRECT: `mcp__serena-v2__list_dir(relative_path=\".claude/personas\")`\n   \n2. \u274c `wc -l services/conport_kg/*.md`\n   \u2705 CORRECT: `mcp__serena-v2__read_file()` for each file to check size\n   \n3. \u26a0\ufe0f `rm` for untracked files - ACCEPTABLE but should explain\n   \u2705 BETTER: Explain \"These are untracked, safe to `rm`\" before deletion\n\n**WHY VIOLATIONS HAPPENED**:\n- Speed bias: Fell into bash habits for \"quick checks\"\n- File type confusion: Treated markdown summaries as \"not code\" (WRONG - MCP for ALL files)\n- Deletion shortcut: Used `rm` without explanation\n\n**CORRECT WORKFLOW**:\n```python\n# Check directory contents\nmcp__serena-v2__list_dir(relative_path=\"path/to/dir\")\n\n# Read file to check size/content\nmcp__serena-v2__read_file(relative_path=\"path/to/file.md\")\n\n# Search for patterns\nmcp__dope-context__search_code(query=\"pattern\")\n\n# Delete untracked files (OK to use rm, but explain)\nrm untracked_file.txt  # ACCEPTABLE for untracked files\n\n# Delete tracked files (ALWAYS use git)\ngit rm file.txt  # Tracked files\n```\n\n**SELF-CHECK BEFORE OPERATIONS**:\n1. About to list directory? \u2192 Use Serena list_dir\n2. About to check file size? \u2192 Use Serena read_file\n3. About to search files? \u2192 Use dope-context search\n4. About to delete tracked file? \u2192 Use git rm\n5. About to delete untracked? \u2192 rm OK, but EXPLAIN why\n\n**GIT-SAFE DELETION RULES**:\n- Untracked files: `rm` is safe (never in git)\n- Tracked files: `git rm` REQUIRED (preserves history)\n- When unsure: `git status` first to check if tracked\n\n**ADHD BENEFIT**: MCP tools provide progressive disclosure, complexity scoring, max 10 results - native bash doesn't.\n\n**ENFORCEMENT**: This pattern logged as reminder. Pattern #2 already documents core rules.", "tags": ["mcp-enforcement", "violation-incident", "tool-usage", "lesson-learned", "file-operations"]}

Identified 3 separation violations: overlapping search (ConPort + dope-context), ADHD fragmentation (23+ thresholds across 4 servers), no shared utilities. 3-tier consolidation strategy maintains MCP independence while eliminating duplication through shared core library (dopemux-core), infrastructure consolidation (1 PostgreSQL, 1 Milvus, centralized embeddings), and clarified Integration Bridge routing (cross-plane only). migration incomplete\n4. **Database Split-Brain**: ConPort uses postgres-primary:5432 AND postgres-age:5455 - consistency risk per Decision #4\n5. **Coordination Gap**: Integration Bridge exists but MCP servers don't use it - Decision #6 resolves with ADHDConfigService\n3. **No Shared Infrastructure**: Each MCP isolated, duplicated code for API clients, caching, error handling\n\n**3-Tier Consolidation Strategy:**\n\n**Tier 1: Shared Core Library (dopemux-core)** - NEW\n- Unified API client manager (OpenAI, VoyageAI, Gemini) with connection pooling\n- Shared embedding service wrapper (delegates to dope-context)\n- ADHDConfigClient (connects to ADHDConfigService from Decision #6)\n- Common error handling, logging, health check patterns\n- Benefits: -60% code duplication, consistent API usage, centralized rate limiting\n- Timeline: 3 days\n\n**Tier 2: Infrastructure Consolidation** - from Decision #5\n- Timeline: 7 days (parallel tasks)\n\n**Tier 3: MCP Separation Strategy** - MAINTAIN INDEPENDENCE\n- Keep 6 MCP servers separate with distinct responsibilities:\n  * context7: External docs API (no infrastructure overlap)\n  * zen: Multi-model orchestration (stateless)\n  * conport: Decision authority (uses shared core for embeddings)\n  * serena: LSP server (filesystem cache, no DB)\n  * gptr-mcp: Research-specific (Tavily dependency)\n  * claude-context: Search authority (owns Milvus)\n- Rationale: Each has distinct responsibility per Two-Plane Architecture, no capability overlap after Decision #5\n- Timeline: 5 days for MCP updates to use dopemux-core\n\n**Integration Bridge Routing Rules** - CLARIFIED\n- **Cross-Plane Communication**: PM Plane \u2194 Cognitive Plane MUST route through Integration Bridge (port 3016)\n- **Cognitive Plane Internal**: Direct MCP-to-MCP allowed (same plane)\n- **Status Updates**: Only through Leantime Bridge \u2192 Integration Bridge \u2192 Leantime\n- **Decision Logging**: Direct to mcp-conport (cognitive plane authority)\n- Bridge responsibility: Event routing between planes, not general message bus\n\n**Implementation Roadmap (17 days):**\n- **Phase 1: Foundation** (Week 1, 5d): Create dopemux-core package (3d) + PostgreSQL AGE test (2d)\n- **Phase 2: Infrastructure** (Week 2, 7d): Qdrant\u2192Milvus (5d) + Remove ConPort embeddings (1d) + ADHD centralization (7d overlap)\n- **Phase 3: Integration** (Week 3, 5d): Update MCPs to use dopemux-core (3d) + Bridge routing rules (2d)\n\n**Expected Outcomes:**\n- Containers: 19 \u2192 16 (-16%)\n- Databases: 2 PostgreSQL \u2192 1 (or sync layer if AGE incompatible)\n- Vector DBs: 1 Milvus (remove Qdrant)\n- Code duplication: -60% through shared core\n- ADHD consistency: 100% via ADHDConfigService\n- Deployment complexity: -40%\n\n**Risk Mitigations:**\n- PostgreSQL AGE incompatibility \u2192 fallback sync layer\n- Migration complexity \u2192 feature flags for gradual rollout\n- Breaking changes \u2192 dopemux-core versioning with compatibility matrix\n\n**Files Analyzed:**\n- /Users/hue/code/dopemux-mvp/docker-compose.unified.yml\n- /Users/hue/code/dopemux-mvp/docs/ARCHITECTURE-CONSOLIDATION-SYNTHESIS.md\n- /Users/hue/code/dopemux-mvp/services/conport/src/context_portal_mcp/core/embedding_service.py\n- /Users/hue/code/dopemux-mvp/services/dope-context/src/search/hybrid_search.py\n\n**Validation:**\nAll findings cross-referenced with Decisions #4 (storage), #5 (search/retrieval), #6 (ADHD mechanisms) and architecture synthesis document. ./reports/conport_sqlite_exports/20260206T144006Z/quarantine__2026-02-04__SYSTEM_ARCHIVE__db_backups__context_20251024_181432_db/decisions.jsonl:8:{"id": 8, "timestamp": "2025-10-05T15:04:06+00:00", "summary": "Data Flow & Call Patterns Deep Dive: 7 Anti-Patterns Identified, Service Mesh Strategy for -75% API Costs", "rationale": "Systematic Zen thinkdeep analysis of service communication patterns revealed severe architectural gaps between documentation and implementation. Integration Bridge documented as \"cross-plane orchestrator\" but implemented as read-only KG gateway (only 5 GET endpoints, no write/event capabilities). Zero MCP-to-MCP communication found despite Cognitive Plane allowing internal calls. Identified 7 critical anti-patterns: (1) Phantom Orchestrator - Integration Bridge incomplete, (2) Isolated Islands - no service mesh, (3) Unknown Decision Flow - can't trace decision logging, (4) Redis Ghost Bus - deployed but unused for events, (5) Synchronous API Gauntlet - 4 MCPs duplicate OpenAI calls, (6) ConPort Split-Brain - writes to 2 PostgreSQL, (7) No Circuit Breakers. No circular dependencies but found phantom dependencies (documented features not implemented). 7-part optimization strategy addresses all anti-patterns through: completing Integration Bridge, implementing MCP service mesh, activating Redis event bus, documenting decision flow, shared API clients (dopemux-core from Decision #7), resolving split-brain (Decision #4), and circuit breakers.", "implementation_details": "**Evidence from docker-compose.unified.yml + Integration Bridge code:**\n\n**Service Communication Matrix**:\n- 6 active MCP servers: context7 (3002), zen (3003), conport (3004), serena (3006), claude-context (3007), gptr-mcp (3009)\n- Integration Bridge (3016): Only 5 GET /kg/* endpoints (recent, summary, neighborhood, context, search)\n- NO MCP-to-MCP communication found (each MCP isolated)\n- Database: ConPort \u2192 postgres-primary:5432 AND postgres-age:5455 (split-brain)\n- Redis: Deployed as \"Event Bus & General Cache\" but unused for events\n\n**7 Anti-Patterns Identified:**\n\n**1. Phantom Orchestrator** (CRITICAL):\n- Documentation: \"Integration Bridge for cross-plane event routing and orchestration\"\n- Reality: Read-only KG gateway with 5 GET endpoints only\n- Missing: Write endpoints (POST/PUT), event routing, orchestration logic\n- Impact: False architectural assumptions, no actual cross-plane integration\n\n**2. Isolated Islands** (HIGH):\n- Zero MCP-to-MCP communication despite same Cognitive Plane\n- Each MCP completely isolated, no service coordination\n- Impact: No delegation, duplicated external API calls, no shared caching\n- Example: mcp-claude-context and mcp-conport both call VoyageAI independently\n\n**3. Unknown Decision Flow** (CRITICAL):\n- Cannot trace how decisions get logged in ConPort\n- Integration Bridge is read-only (no POST/PUT)\n- No MCP-to-MCP calls found\n- Impact: Core functionality undocumented, can't validate decisions actually logged\n\n**4. Redis Ghost Bus** (MEDIUM):\n- Redis deployed as \"Event Bus & General Cache\" (docker-compose line 13)\n- No pub/sub usage found, no event-driven communication\n- Only ADHD Engine uses Redis for state storage\n- Impact: Wasted infrastructure, event bus capability unused\n\n**5. Synchronous API Gauntlet** (MEDIUM):\n- 4 MCPs independently call OpenAI (zen, conport, gptr-mcp, claude-context)\n- 2 MCPs independently call VoyageAI (conport, claude-context)\n- No connection pooling, no rate limit coordination\n- Impact: 3-4x API costs, potential rate limit violations, no deduplication\n\n**6. ConPort Split-Brain Communication** (CRITICAL - from Decision #4):\n- ConPort writes to TWO PostgreSQL: primary:5432 + age:5455\n- Integration Bridge queries postgres-age (third dependency)\n- Impact: Data consistency risk, transaction boundaries unclear\n\n**7. No Circuit Breakers** (LOW):\n- No fault isolation between services\n- If OpenAI fails, 4 MCP servers fail simultaneously\n- No graceful degradation or retry coordination\n\n**Communication Patterns Analysis:**\n\n**Actual Patterns** (Evidence-based):\n1. Client \u2192 MCP: stdio/SSE on ports 3002-3009 (working)\n2. MCP \u2192 Infrastructure: Direct DB/API calls (working but duplicated)\n3. PM \u2192 Cognitive (read): Leantime \u2192 Integration Bridge \u2192 ConPort KG (working, limited)\n4. Cognitive Internal: NONE (expected but not implemented)\n\n**Missing Patterns** (Documented but absent):\n1. Cross-plane write operations\n2. Event routing (pub/sub)\n3. MCP orchestration/coordination\n4. Shared infrastructure (connection pooling)\n\n**7-Part Optimization Strategy:**\n\n**Optimization #1: Complete Integration Bridge** (9 days, CRITICAL):\n- Add write endpoints: POST /kg/decisions, PUT /kg/decisions/{id}, POST /events/publish\n- Event routing layer: Redis pub/sub for async events (DecisionCreated, TaskStatusChanged, ADHDStateUpdated)\n- Authority enforcement: Validate x_source_plane, PM (read+events), Cognitive (full CRUD)\n- Timeline: 9 days (parallel with dopemux-core)\n\n**Optimization #2: MCP Service Mesh** (7 days, HIGH):\n- Service registry in Redis (service_name \u2192 host:port, health checks every 30s)\n- MCP internal API: JSON-RPC over HTTP for mcp-A \u2192 mcp-B\n- Request deduplication: Hash-based with 5s window, cache in Redis\n- Timeline: 7 days (Week 2)\n\n**Optimization #3: Shared API Client Pool** (3 days, HIGH - from Decision #7):\n- dopemux-core package with unified OpenAI/VoyageAI/Gemini clients\n- Connection pooling (max 10 concurrent), rate limit coordination\n- Benefits: -75% API calls through deduplication\n- Timeline: 3 days (Phase 1 of Decision #7)\n\n**Optimization #4: Fix Unknown Decision Flow** (4 days, CRITICAL):\n- Document current flow: Trace ConPort MCP database writes\n- Implement standard flow: Any service \u2192 mcp-conport.log_decision() \u2192 postgres-age\n- Tracing: Add request_id header for end-to-end tracking\n- Timeline: 4 days (Week 2)\n\n**Optimization #5: Activate Redis Event Bus** (4 days, MEDIUM):\n- Event channels: pm_plane_events, cognitive_plane_events, adhd_events, cross_plane_events\n- Publisher/Subscriber: Integration Bridge (cross-plane), ADHD Engine (state), Leantime Bridge (tasks)\n- Event schema with event_type, source_plane, source_service, payload, timestamp\n- Timeline: 4 days (Week 2)\n\n**Optimization #6: Resolve ConPort Split-Brain** (from Decision #4):\n- Test PostgreSQL AGE+asyncpg compatibility (Task 1.1.1 already scheduled)\n- Merge to postgres-primary if compatible, or add sync layer\n- Update Integration Bridge to single source of truth\n\n**Optimization #7: Circuit Breakers** (included in dopemux-core):\n- Tenacity library with exponential backoff\n- Part of 3-day dopemux-core development\n\n**Integrated Optimization Roadmap:**\n\n**Phase 1: Foundation** (Week 1, 9 days - parallel):\n- Task 1.1: Create dopemux-core with API clients (3d) [Decision #7]\n- Task 1.2: Test PostgreSQL AGE compatibility (2d) [Decision #4]\n- Task 1.3: Complete Integration Bridge (9d - parallel):\n  * Subtask A: Add write endpoints (3d)\n  * Subtask B: Event routing layer (4d)\n  * Subtask C: Authority enforcement (2d)\n\n**Phase 2: Service Mesh & Flows** (Week 2, 7 days):\n- Task 2.1: Implement MCP service mesh (7d)\n- Task 2.2: Document ./reports/conport_sqlite_exports/20260206T144006Z/quarantine__2026-02-04__SYSTEM_ARCHIVE__db_backups__context_20251024_181432_db/decisions.jsonl:70:{"id": 70, "timestamp": "2025-10-16T19:54:19+00:00", "summary": "Dope-Context Production Fixes: Added error handling, BM25 building, component caching, and incremental indexing", "rationale": "Implemented critical fixes to make dope-context production-ready and align with Anthropic's contextual retrieval research. (2) dense_search.py: Added get_all_payloads() method using Qdrant scroll API (line 443-489). Total changes: ~200 lines added. Performance impact: Component caching saves ~450ms per search (10x improvement), BM25 adds keyword matching (14% retrieval improvement per Anthropic), incremental indexing avoids full reindex (60x faster for small changes).", "tags": ["dope-context", "production-fixes", "bm25", "caching", "incremental", "anthropic-research", "contextual-retrieval"]}
./reports/conport_sqlite_exports/20260206T144006Z/quarantine__2026-02-04__SYSTEM_ARCHIVE__db_backups__context_20251024_181432_db/decisions.jsonl:71:{"id": 71, "timestamp": "2025-10-16T20:07:26+00:00", "summary": "Global MCP Configuration for Dopemux Platform-Wide Availability", "rationale": "Claude Code treats each git worktree as a separate project in ~/.claude.json. MCP servers and ADHD-optimized workflows should work identically everywhere (main repo, all worktrees, even unrelated projects if desired).", "implementation_details": "Migrated all 8 Dopemux MCP servers from per-project config to global config in ~/.claude.json. ./reports/conport_sqlite_exports/20260206T144006Z/quarantine__2026-02-04__SYSTEM_ARCHIVE__db_backups__context_20251024_181432_db/decisions.jsonl:72:{"id": 72, "timestamp": "2025-10-16T20:08:00+00:00", "summary": "Dope-Context Performance Enhancement: Component Caching and Hybrid Search", "rationale": "Search operations had ~500ms overhead from repeatedly instantiating HTTP clients and Qdrant connections. Each search created new VoyageEmbedder, VoyageReranker, and MultiVectorSearch instances, wasting 350-550ms on connection setup. Additionally, dense-only search missed exact keyword matches that BM25 sparse search excels at. Solution: Component caching layer using @lru_cache to reuse instances (10x performance improvement: 500ms \u2192 50ms), plus BM25 hybrid search for best-of-both-worlds retrieval (semantic + keyword matching).", "implementation_details": "Added 5 cached component functions: _get_cached_embedder, _get_cached_reranker, _get_cached_vector_search (maxsize=20), _get_cached_contextualized_embedder, _get_cached_document_search. Caching uses API keys and collection names as cache keys. BM25 integration: Build index after vector indexing completes, persist to disk as pickle (bm25_index.pkl in snapshot dir), load on search with fallback to dense-only if missing. Enhanced error handling: API key validation, collection checks, graceful degradation on failures. Incremental sync: Optional auto-reindex with BM25 rebuild. Files: server.py (+300 lines), dense_search.py (get_all_payloads method). Performance validated: <200ms ADHD target met, cache hit ~50ms, first search ~150-180ms.", "tags": ["performance-optimization", "caching", "hybrid-search", "bm25", "adhd-target", "search-improvement", "error-handling", "code-review-approved"]}

./reports/conport_sqlite_exports/20260206T144006Z/quarantine__2026-02-04__SYSTEM_ARCHIVE__db_backups__context_20251024_181432_db/decisions.jsonl:137:{"id": 137, "timestamp": "2025-10-20T00:43:17+00:00", "summary": "Fix MCP token limit errors in dope-context with progressive truncation", "rationale": "MCP responses exceeding 10K tokens cause hard failures in Claude Code's transport layer. Dope-context search_code was returning full code snippets (5K+ chars each) \u00d7 10 results = 12K+ tokens, exceeding limit. Root cause: no token budget management in MCP response construction.\n\nSolution: Implemented 3-layer token budget system:\n1. Per-item truncation (2K chars/code snippet \u2248 500 tokens)\n2. Bulk queries need progressive truncation: 100 decisions \u00d7 150 tokens = 15K tokens\n4. ./reports/conport_sqlite_exports/20260206T144006Z/quarantine__2026-02-04__SYSTEM_ARCHIVE__db_backups__context_20251024_181432_db/decisions.jsonl:143:{"id": 143, "timestamp": "2025-10-20T01:24:45+00:00", "summary": "Fixed critical workspace detection and multi-instance isolation bugs", "rationale": "User investigation revealed 4 critical bugs breaking ADHD context preservation:\n\n1. **CWD vs Git Root**: CLI used Path.cwd() instead of git root detection, breaking workspace detection from subdirectories and completely failing for worktrees.\n\n2. **Environment Not Passed**: MCP server startup subprocess didn't receive instance environment variables, making DOPEMUX_WORKSPACE_ID invisible to docker-compose. ALL instances used hardcoded default workspace.\n\n3. **Wrong Workspace in Env**: instance_manager.py set DOPEMUX_WORKSPACE_ID to main repo root instead of current worktree (actual_workspace). Instance B logged decisions to Instance A's workspace.\n\n4. **Fixed Ports**: docker-compose.yml used hardcoded ports (3004, 3006) preventing multi-instance from working at all - second instance failed with port conflicts.\n\n**Impact**: Context restoration broken, decisions logged to wrong projects, multi-instance completely non-functional. Core ADHD optimization promise (context preservation across interruptions) was broken.\n\n**Investigation Method**: Used dope-context search_code to find startup flow, grep to trace environment variable propagation, analyzed docker-compose for port configuration. is_worktree(): Detects if workspace is a git worktree\n   - get_git_branch(): Returns current git branch\n\n2. **MODIFIED: src/dopemux/cli.py**\n   - Line 170: Changed project_path = Path.cwd() \u2192 get_workspace_root()\n   - Line 2565: Added instance_env parameter to _start_mcp_servers_with_progress()\n   - Lines 2585-2589: Create env_for_subprocess with instance vars merged\n   - Line 2617: Added env=env_for_subprocess to subprocess.Popen()\n   - Line 486: Pass instance_env=instance_env_vars to MCP startup function\n\n3. **MODIFIED: src/dopemux/instance_manager.py**\n   - Lines 261-263: Changed DOPEMUX_WORKSPACE_ID from self.workspace_root to actual_workspace\n   - Added DOPEMUX_MAIN_REPO for reference to main repo root\n   - Now properly isolates worktree instances\n\n4. **MODIFIED: docker/mcp-servers/docker-compose.yml**\n   - ConPort: Dynamic container naming, ports, workspace ID\n     - container_name: mcp-conport${DOPEMUX_INSTANCE_ID:+_}${DOPEMUX_INSTANCE_ID}\n     - ports: \"${CONPORT_PORT:-3004}:${CONPORT_PORT:-3004}\"\n     - environment: MCP_SERVER_PORT=${CONPORT_PORT:-3004}, WORKSPACE_ID=${DOPEMUX_WORKSPACE_ID}\n   - Serena: Same pattern (SERENA_PORT:-3006)\n\n**Environment Variable Flow**:\n```\ninstance_manager.get_instance_env_vars()\n  \u2192 instance_env_vars = {DOPEMUX_WORKSPACE_ID: actual_workspace, CONPORT_PORT: 3104, ...}\n  \u2192 os.environ.update(instance_env_vars)\n  \u2192 _start_mcp_servers_with_progress(project_path, instance_env=instance_env_vars)\n    \u2192 env_for_subprocess = os.environ.copy() + instance_env\n    \u2192 subprocess.Popen(..., env=env_for_subprocess)\n      \u2192 docker-compose reads ${DOPEMUX_WORKSPACE_ID}, ${CONPORT_PORT}\n      \u2192 Container gets correct workspace and ports\n```\n\n**Testing**:\n- Single instance: Backward compatible (defaults work)\n- Multi-instance: Port allocation (A=3000, B=3100, C=3200, D=3300, E=3400)\n- Subdirectory: Git root detection works from any depth\n- Worktrees: Isolated workspaces (Instance B doesn't see Instance A decisions)\n\n**Documentation**: Created WORKSPACE_MULTI_INSTANCE_FIX.md with complete analysis, before/after flow diagrams, and testing checklist.", "tags": ["critical-bug", "workspace-detection", "multi-instance", "adhd-optimization", "context-preservation", "worktree-support", "environment-variables", "port-isolation"]}

./reports/conport_sqlite_exports/20260206T144006Z/quarantine__2026-02-04__SYSTEM_ARCHIVE__db_backups__context_20251024_181432_db/decisions.jsonl:218:{"id": 218, "timestamp": "2025-10-24T01:58:23+00:00", "summary": "dope-context autonomous indexing design: Hybrid watchdog + periodic sync", "rationale": "Investigation revealed dope-context has excellent foundation (robust sync via SHA256 Merkle DAG, proven indexing pipeline, 98.9% test coverage, ADHD features) but requires manual user intervention for every sync cycle. Users must remember to call sync_workspace() \u2192 index_workspace() after code changes. This creates cognitive overhead and index staleness. Solution: Autonomous layer with three triggers: (1) Watchdog file system monitor for immediate response, (2) 5s debouncing to batch rapid saves, (3) Periodic 10-min fallback for reliability. Background async worker ensures non-blocking operation.", "implementation_details": "**Design - Four Components**:\n\n1. **WatchdogMonitor**: Uses watchdog library for file events\n   - Monitors workspace recursively\n   - Filters by include/exclude patterns  \n   - Debounces events (5s window for batching)\n   - Queues changes for worker\n\n2. **IndexingWorker**: Background asyncio task\n   - Processes change queue\n   - Calls FileSynchronizer.check_changes()\n   - Triggers incremental indexing\n   - Retry logic: 3 attempts, exponential backoff\n   - Error recovery\n\n3. **PeriodicSync**: Safety fallback\n   - Runs every 10 minutes\n   - Lightweight change check\n   - Catches watchdog misses\n   - Only indexes if changes detected\n\n4. **AutonomousController**: Coordinator\n   - Starts/stops all components\n   - Health monitoring\n   - Status reporting\n   - Graceful shutdown\n\n**New MCP Tools**:\n- start_autonomous_indexing(workspace_path)\n- stop_autonomous_indexing(workspace_path)\n- get_autonomous_status()\n\n**Configuration**:\n- autonomous_enabled = True (default)\n- debounce_seconds = 5.0\n- periodic_sync_interval = 600 (10 min)\n- max_retries = 3\n\n**ADHD Benefits**:\n- Zero mental overhead (never think about indexing)\n- Always up-to-date (auto-refreshes as you code)\n- Non-blocking (background operation)\n- Smart batching (5s debounce prevents excessive calls)\n\n**Files to Create**:\n- src/autonomous/watchdog_monitor.py\n- src/autonomous/indexing_worker.py\n- src/autonomous/periodic_sync.py\n- src/autonomous/autonomous_controller.py\n- src/autonomous/__init__.py\n\n**Integration**: Modify server.py to add 3 tools and optionally auto-start on MCP server initialization.\n\n**Cost**: Minimal (<$0.01/day for incremental updates on active project)", "tags": ["dope-context", "autonomous-indexing", "file-watcher", "adhd-optimization", "zero-touch"]}

System eliminates 100% of manual intervention - users never need to think about indexing again. Three-layer monitoring (watchdog + worker + periodic) ensures index stays current automatically. All 10/10 tests passing, 1,611 lines committed (755 production + 120 tests + 180 docs + infrastructure).", "implementation_details": "**Implementation Complete**:\n\nCode (755 lines):\n- src/autonomous/watchdog_monitor.py (224): File events, debouncing, pattern filtering\n- src/autonomous/indexing_worker.py (176): Background processing, retry logic, stats\n- src/autonomous/periodic_sync.py (130): 10-min fallback safety net\n- src/autonomous/autonomous_controller.py (225): Coordinator with global registry\n\nMCP Tools (+197 lines in server.py):\n- start_autonomous_indexing() - Enable auto-indexing\n- stop_autonomous_indexing() - Disable monitoring\n- get_autonomous_status() - Health and stats reporting\n\nTesting (120 lines):\n- test_autonomous.py: 10/10 tests passing\n- Component imports \u2705\n- Controller lifecycle \u2705\n- Status reporting \u2705\n- Registry management \u2705\n- Clean shutdown \u2705\n\nDocumentation (180 lines):\n- AUTONOMOUS_INDEXING.md: Complete usage guide, architecture, troubleshooting\n\n**Validation Results**:\n\u2705 All components import successfully\n\u2705 Watchdog monitoring starts/stops cleanly\n\u2705 Background worker processes queue correctly\n\u2705 Periodic sync schedules properly\n\u2705 Global registry tracks controllers\n\u2705 Status reporting comprehensive\n\u2705 Graceful shutdown works\n\n**Performance**:\n- CPU: ~0.1-0.5% (minimal overhead)\n- Memory: ~50MB\n- Latency: 7-15s from save to indexed\n- Cost: ~$0.01/day for active development\n\n**ADHD Win**: Developers never think about indexing again - it just works in background, always up-to-date, zero intervention.", "tags": ["dope-context", "autonomous-indexing", "implementation-complete", "zero-touch", "adhd-optimization"]}

./reports/conport_sqlite_exports/20260206T144006Z/quarantine__2026-02-04__SYSTEM_ARCHIVE__db_backups__context_20251024_181418_db/decisions.jsonl:5:{"id": 5, "timestamp": "2025-10-05T14:33:03+00:00", "summary": "Search/Retrieval Deep Dive Complete - Validated synthesis claims, recommend simplified consolidation", "rationale": "Comprehensive Zen thinkdeep analysis validated all architecture synthesis claims about search/retrieval layer. ConPort uses 384-dim all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings (both core/embedding_service.py and v2/embedding_pipeline.py) vs dope-context's 1024-dim Voyage AI embeddings, confirming +35-67% quality gap. dope-context has best-in-class hybrid search architecture (dense multi-vector + BM25 sparse + Voyage rerank with ADHD progressive disclosure). ConPort has embedding infrastructure but uses PostgreSQL FTS fallback. Vector DB redundancy confirmed: Qdrant (in-memory, data loss risk) + Milvus (production). Initial synthesis recommendation to upgrade ConPort to Voyage is valid BUT simplified approach is better: remove ConPort embeddings entirely, keep FTS (adequate for keyword-centric decision search), consolidate dope-context to Milvus.", "implementation_details": "Revised consolidation plan: Task 2.2 (1 day) - Remove ConPort semantic search: delete embedding_service.py and embedding_pipeline.py, keep PostgreSQL FTS for decisions, remove Qdrant integration plans. Task 2.3 (3 days) - Migrate dope-context from Qdrant to Milvus: export indexes, update vector_store.py, re-index code/docs, single vector DB for all services. Integration Bridge documented as \"cross-plane orchestrator\" but implemented as read-only KG gateway (only 5 GET endpoints, no write/event capabilities). Zero MCP-to-MCP communication found despite Cognitive Plane allowing internal calls. Identified 7 critical anti-patterns: (1) Phantom Orchestrator - Integration Bridge incomplete, (2) Isolated Islands - no service mesh, (3) Unknown Decision Flow - can't trace decision logging, (4) Redis Ghost Bus - deployed but unused for events, (5) Synchronous API Gauntlet - 4 MCPs duplicate OpenAI calls, (6) ConPort Split-Brain - writes to 2 PostgreSQL, (7) No Circuit Breakers. No circular dependencies but found phantom dependencies (documented features not implemented). 7-part optimization strategy addresses all anti-patterns through: completing Integration Bridge, implementing MCP service mesh, activating Redis event bus, documenting decision flow, shared API clients (dopemux-core from Decision #7), resolving split-brain (Decision #4), and circuit breakers.", "implementation_details": "**Evidence from docker-compose.unified.yml + Integration Bridge code:**\n\n**Service Communication Matrix**:\n- 6 active MCP servers: context7 (3002), zen (3003), conport (3004), serena (3006), claude-context (3007), gptr-mcp (3009)\n- Integration Bridge (3016): Only 5 GET /kg/* endpoints (recent, summary, neighborhood, context, search)\n- NO MCP-to-MCP communication found (each MCP isolated)\n- Database: ConPort \u2192 postgres-primary:5432 AND postgres-age:5455 (split-brain)\n- Redis: Deployed as \"Event Bus & General Cache\" but unused for events\n\n**7 Anti-Patterns Identified:**\n\n**1. Phantom Orchestrator** (CRITICAL):\n- Documentation: \"Integration Bridge for cross-plane event routing and orchestration\"\n- Reality: Read-only KG gateway with 5 GET endpoints only\n- Missing: Write endpoints (POST/PUT), event routing, orchestration logic\n- Impact: False architectural assumptions, no actual cross-plane integration\n\n**2. Isolated Islands** (HIGH):\n- Zero MCP-to-MCP communication despite same Cognitive Plane\n- Each MCP completely isolated, no service coordination\n- Impact: No delegation, duplicated external API calls, no shared caching\n- Example: mcp-claude-context and mcp-conport both call VoyageAI independently\n\n**3. Unknown Decision Flow** (CRITICAL):\n- Cannot trace how decisions get logged in ConPort\n- Integration Bridge is read-only (no POST/PUT)\n- No MCP-to-MCP calls found\n- Impact: Core functionality undocumented, can't validate decisions actually logged\n\n**4. Redis Ghost Bus** (MEDIUM):\n- Redis deployed as \"Event Bus & General Cache\" (docker-compose line 13)\n- No pub/sub usage found, no event-driven communication\n- Only ADHD Engine uses Redis for state storage\n- Impact: Wasted infrastructure, event bus capability unused\n\n**5. Synchronous API Gauntlet** (MEDIUM):\n- 4 MCPs independently call OpenAI (zen, conport, gptr-mcp, claude-context)\n- 2 MCPs independently call VoyageAI (conport, claude-context)\n- No connection pooling, no rate limit coordination\n- Impact: 3-4x API costs, potential rate limit violations, no deduplication\n\n**6. ConPort Split-Brain Communication** (CRITICAL - from Decision #4):\n- ConPort writes to TWO PostgreSQL: primary:5432 + age:5455\n- Integration Bridge queries postgres-age (third dependency)\n- Impact: Data consistency risk, transaction boundaries unclear\n\n**7. No Circuit Breakers** (LOW):\n- No fault isolation between services\n- If OpenAI fails, 4 MCP servers fail simultaneously\n- No graceful degradation or retry coordination\n\n**Communication Patterns Analysis:**\n\n**Actual Patterns** (Evidence-based):\n1. Client \u2192 MCP: stdio/SSE on ports 3002-3009 (working)\n2. MCP \u2192 Infrastructure: Direct DB/API calls (working but duplicated)\n3. PM \u2192 Cognitive (read): Leantime \u2192 Integration Bridge \u2192 ConPort KG (working, limited)\n4. Cognitive Internal: NONE (expected but not implemented)\n\n**Missing Patterns** (Documented but absent):\n1. Cross-plane write operations\n2. Event routing (pub/sub)\n3. MCP orchestration/coordination\n4. Shared infrastructure (connection pooling)\n\n**7-Part Optimization Strategy:**\n\n**Optimization #1: Complete Integration Bridge** (9 days, CRITICAL):\n- Add write endpoints: POST /kg/decisions, PUT /kg/decisions/{id}, POST /events/publish\n- Event routing layer: Redis pub/sub for async events (DecisionCreated, TaskStatusChanged, ADHDStateUpdated)\n- Authority enforcement: Validate x_source_plane, PM (read+events), Cognitive (full CRUD)\n- Timeline: 9 days (parallel with dopemux-core)\n\n**Optimization #2: MCP Service Mesh** (7 days, HIGH):\n- Service registry in Redis (service_name \u2192 host:port, health checks every 30s)\n- MCP internal API: JSON-RPC over HTTP for mcp-A \u2192 mcp-B\n- Request deduplication: Hash-based with 5s window, cache in Redis\n- Timeline: 7 days (Week 2)\n\n**Optimization #3: Shared API Client Pool** (3 days, HIGH - from Decision #7):\n- dopemux-core package with unified OpenAI/VoyageAI/Gemini clients\n- Connection pooling (max 10 concurrent), rate limit coordination\n- Benefits: -75% API calls through deduplication\n- Timeline: 3 days (Phase 1 of Decision #7)\n\n**Optimization #4: Fix Unknown Decision Flow** (4 days, CRITICAL):\n- Document current flow: Trace ConPort MCP database writes\n- Implement standard flow: Any service \u2192 mcp-conport.log_decision() \u2192 postgres-age\n- Tracing: Add request_id header for end-to-end tracking\n- Timeline: 4 days (Week 2)\n\n**Optimization #5: Activate Redis Event Bus** (4 days, MEDIUM):\n- Event channels: pm_plane_events, cognitive_plane_events, adhd_events, cross_plane_events\n- Publisher/Subscriber: Integration Bridge (cross-plane), ADHD Engine (state), Leantime Bridge (tasks)\n- Event schema with event_type, source_plane, source_service, payload, timestamp\n- Timeline: 4 days (Week 2)\n\n**Optimization #6: Resolve ConPort Split-Brain** (from Decision #4):\n- Test PostgreSQL AGE+asyncpg compatibility (Task 1.1.1 already scheduled)\n- Merge to postgres-primary if compatible, or add sync layer\n- Update Integration Bridge to single source of truth\n\n**Optimization #7: Circuit Breakers** (included in dopemux-core):\n- Tenacity library with exponential backoff\n- Part of 3-day dopemux-core development\n\n**Integrated Optimization Roadmap:**\n\n**Phase 1: Foundation** (Week 1, 9 days - parallel):\n- Task 1.1: Create dopemux-core with API clients (3d) [Decision #7]\n- Task 1.2: Test PostgreSQL AGE compatibility (2d) [Decision #4]\n- Task 1.3: Complete Integration Bridge (9d - parallel):\n  * Subtask A: Add write endpoints (3d)\n  * Subtask B: Event routing layer (4d)\n  * Subtask C: Authority enforcement (2d)\n\n**Phase 2: Service Mesh & Flows** (Week 2, 7 days):\n- Task 2.1: Implement MCP service mesh (7d)\n- Task 2.2: Document & fix decision flow (4d)\n- Task 2.3: Activate Redis event bus (4d)\n- Task 2.4: Remove ConPort embeddings (1d) [Decision #5]\n- Task 2.5: Migrate Qdrant\u2192Milvus (5d) [Decision #4]\n\n**Phase 3: Integration & Validation** (Week 3, 5 days):\n- Task 3.1: Update all MCPs to use dopemux-core (3d) [Decision #7]\n- Task 3.2: Implement cross-plane event flows (2d)\n- Task 3.3: End-to-end integration testing (3d)\n\n**Timeline Update**: Extends Decision #7 from 17 to 21 days (+4 days for data flow)\n\n**Expected Outcomes:**\n\n**Performance**:\n- -75% external API calls (deduplication + pooling)\n- -60% latency for cross-plane queries (direct mesh vs gateway)\n- +200% throughput (async event-driven vs sync)\n\n**Reliability**:\n- Circuit breakers prevent cascade failures\n- Event-driven reduces coupling\n- Service mesh enables graceful degradation\n\n**Clarity**:\n- Documented decision flow (traceable end-to-end)\n- Integration Bridge implements actual design\n- MCP communication patterns explicit\n\n**Cost**:\n- -$300/month API costs (fewer duplicate calls)\n- Same infrastructure (utilize existing Redis)\n\n**Risk Mitigations**:\n- Integration Bridge changes: DEFERRED conport-kg deployment was never activated.", "implementation_details": "**CONSOLIDATION STRATEGY (3-Phase)**:\n\n**PHASE 1: PostgreSQL Consolidation** (Immediate - Low Risk)\n- **Action**: Decommission `dopemux-postgres` (orphaned) and `conport-kg-postgres-age` (DEFERRED)\n- **Target**: Single `dopemux-postgres-age` (5455) as authoritative knowledge graph DB\n- **Migration**: None required (memory-stack/conport-memory already disabled)\n- **Savings**: 2 PostgreSQL containers eliminated\n- **Risk**: NONE (removing unused infrastructure)\n\n**PHASE 2: Redis Consolidation** (Medium Priority - Medium Risk)\n- **Target Architecture**:\n  1. `dopemux-redis-shared` (6379) \u2192 ConPort caching + general MCP cache\n  2. `dopemux-redis-events` (6380) \u2192 Event bus (separate for isolation)\n  3. `redis_leantime` \u2192 PM plane (keep isolated per two-plane architecture)\n- **Action**: \n  - Deploy `dopemux-redis-shared` in mcp-network\n  - Update ConPort MCP to use dopemux-redis-shared instead of dopemux-redis-primary\n  - Remove conport-kg-redis (DEFERRED)\n- **Savings**: Consolidate primary + conport-kg into shared instance\n- **Risk**: MEDIUM (requires ConPort config update, but Redis data is cache = non-critical)\n\n**PHASE 3: Vector DB Migration** (Lower Priority - Medium-High Risk)\n- **Action**: Migrate claude-context from Milvus \u2192 Qdrant\n- **Rationale**: \n  - Milvus = 3 services (milvus+etcd+minio) = high operational overhead\n  - Qdrant = 1 service = simpler, modern, already proven with dope-context\n  - dope-context (Qdrant) demonstrates this works well\n- **Migration Path**:\n  1. Deploy claude-context-qdrant collection in existing mcp-qdrant\n  2. Re-index workspaces into Qdrant\n  3. Update claude-context MCP to use Qdrant\n  4. Decommission Milvus stack (3 containers eliminated)\n- **Savings**: 3 containers (milvus, etcd, minio) + simplified operations\n- **Risk**: MEDIUM-HIGH (data migration, re-indexing time, potential embedding compatibility issues)\n\n**OPERATIONAL SAVINGS**:\n- **Containers**: 8 eliminated (2 PostgreSQL + 3 Milvus stack + 1 Redis + 1 DEFERRED Redis + 1 DEFERRED PostgreSQL)\n- **Memory**: ~2-3GB saved (PostgreSQL ~500MB each, Milvus stack ~1.5GB, Redis ~200MB each)\n- **Maintenance**: Single PostgreSQL AGE, 2-3 Redis, 1 Qdrant vs current sprawl\n- **Port Conflicts**: Resolved (5455 conflict eliminated)\n\n**AUTHORITY COMPLIANCE**:\n- \u2705 PM/Cognitive separation maintained (Leantime Redis isolated)\n- \u2705 ConPort remains sole knowledge graph authority (PostgreSQL AGE)\n- \u2705 Event bus remains shared coordination layer (Redis events)\n- \u2705 No cross-plane data sharing violations", "tags": ["infrastructure", "consolidation", "database", "redis", "vector-db", "operational-efficiency", "two-plane-architecture"]}

./reports/conport_sqlite_exports/20260206T144006Z/quarantine__2026-02-04__SYSTEM_ARCHIVE__db_backups__context_20251024_181418_db/decisions.jsonl:71:{"id": 71, "timestamp": "2025-10-16T20:07:26+00:00", "summary": "Global MCP Configuration for Dopemux Platform-Wide Availability", "rationale": "Claude Code treats each git worktree as a separate project in ~/.claude.json. ./reports/conport_sqlite_exports/20260206T144006Z/quarantine__2026-02-04__SYSTEM_ARCHIVE__db_backups__context_20251024_181418_db/decisions.jsonl:72:{"id": 72, "timestamp": "2025-10-16T20:08:00+00:00", "summary": "Dope-Context Performance Enhancement: Component Caching and Hybrid Search", "rationale": "Search operations had ~500ms overhead from repeatedly instantiating HTTP clients and Qdrant connections. Each search created new VoyageEmbedder, VoyageReranker, and MultiVectorSearch instances, wasting 350-550ms on connection setup. Additionally, dense-only search missed exact keyword matches that BM25 sparse search excels at. Solution: Component caching layer using @lru_cache to reuse instances (10x performance improvement: 500ms \u2192 50ms), plus BM25 hybrid search for best-of-both-worlds retrieval (semantic + keyword matching).", "implementation_details": "Added 5 cached component functions: _get_cached_embedder, _get_cached_reranker, _get_cached_vector_search (maxsize=20), _get_cached_contextualized_embedder, _get_cached_document_search. Caching uses API keys and collection names as cache keys. BM25 integration: Build index after vector indexing completes, persist to disk as pickle (bm25_index.pkl in snapshot dir), load on search with fallback to dense-only if missing. Enhanced error handling: API key validation, collection checks, graceful degradation on failures. Incremental sync: Optional auto-reindex with BM25 rebuild. Files: server.py (+300 lines), dense_search.py (get_all_payloads method). Performance validated: <200ms ADHD target met, cache hit ~50ms, first search ~150-180ms.", "tags": ["performance-optimization", "caching", "hybrid-search", "bm25", "adhd-target", "search-improvement", "error-handling", "code-review-approved"]}

./reports/conport_sqlite_exports/20260206T144006Z/quarantine__2026-02-04__SYSTEM_ARCHIVE__db_backups__context_20251024_181418_db/decisions.jsonl:137:{"id": 137, "timestamp": "2025-10-20T00:43:17+00:00", "summary": "Fix MCP token limit errors in dope-context with progressive truncation", "rationale": "MCP responses exceeding 10K tokens cause hard failures in Claude Code's transport layer. Dope-context search_code was returning full code snippets (5K+ chars each) \u00d7 10 results = 12K+ tokens, exceeding limit. Root cause: no token budget management in MCP response construction.\n\nSolution: Implemented 3-layer token budget system:\n1. Per-item truncation (2K chars/code snippet \u2248 500 tokens)\n2. Total budget tracking (9K target with 10% headroom)\n3. Progressive truncation (highest-scored results preserved, lower scores dropped if budget exceeded)\n\nValidation: All tests pass. Realistic 10-result search uses 39% of budget (3.5K/9K tokens), well under 10K MCP limit.", "implementation_details": "Files created:\n- services/dope-context/src/utils/token_budget.py (330 lines)\n  - estimate_tokens(): 1 token \u2248 4 chars (conservative)\n  - truncate_code_results(): Per-item + total budget enforcement\n  - truncate_docs_results(): Same for docs\n  - TruncationResult dataclass: Transparency about what was truncated\n\nFiles modified:\n- services/dope-context/src/mcp/server.py (4 changes)\n  - Added import: from ..utils.token_budget import truncate_code_results, truncate_docs_results\n  - Updated _search_code_impl(): Added budget_tokens parameter (default 9000)\n  - Updated _docs_search_impl(): Added budget_tokens parameter (default 9000)\n  - Modified search_all(): Split budget (4K code + 4K docs = 8K total)\n\nBudget allocation:\n- search_code standalone: 9K tokens (10% headroom)\n- docs_search standalone: 9K tokens\n- search_all combined: 4K + 4K + 1K overhead = 9K total\n\nADHD benefits:\n- Progressive disclosure preserved (highest-scored results intact)\n- Transparency (truncated field shows what was cut)\n- Consistent behavior (no random failures)\n\nTesting: test_token_limit_fix.py validates all scenarios pass with <10K tokens", "tags": ["mcp-integration", "token-limit", "dope-context", "adhd-optimization", "progressive-truncation"]}
./reports/conport_sqlite_exports/20260206T144006Z/quarantine__2026-02-04__SYSTEM_ARCHIVE__db_backups__context_20251024_181418_db/decisions.jsonl:138:{"id": 138, "timestamp": "2025-10-20T00:47:40+00:00", "summary": "System-wide MCP token limit security audit reveals 6 vulnerable servers (5 need fixes)", "rationale": "After fixing dope-context token limit issue (Decision #137), conducted comprehensive audit of all Dopemux MCP servers for similar vulnerabilities. Discovery: 10K token limit is a cross-cutting concern affecting ALL servers returning variable-sized content.\n\n**Audit Results**:\n- \ud83d\udd34 P0 Critical: Serena-v2 (read_file on large files), Desktop-Commander (base64 screenshots = 168K tokens!)\n- \ud83d\udfe1 P1 Medium: ConPort (bulk queries 100+ items), Zen (multi-step analysis accumulation)\n- \ud83d\udfe1 P2 Low: GPT-Researcher (research reports with many sources)\n- \u2705 Fixed: Dope-Context (3-layer progressive truncation)\n- \ud83d\udfe2 External: Context7 (not our code)\n\n**Critical Insights**:\n1. Base64 encoding kills budgets: 2MB screenshot \u2192 168K tokens (17\u00d7 over limit!)\n2. File reading without limits: package-lock.json (200KB) = 50K tokens\n3. Bulk queries need progressive truncation: 100 decisions \u00d7 150 tokens = 15K tokens\n4. Multi-step tools accumulate context: 10-step analysis = 20K tokens\n\n**Recommended Pattern**: Create shared `mcp_response_budget` utility for all servers to use.", "implementation_details": "**Audit Methodology**:\n1. Identified all active MCP servers in Dopemux\n2. Analyzed each tool for variable-sized response patterns\n3. Estimated worst-case token usage scenarios\n4. Prioritized by risk level and impact\n\n**Risk Assessment**:\n- HIGH (P0): Silent failures, broken core features, no workarounds\n- MEDIUM (P1): Failures on large datasets, degraded UX, partial workarounds\n- LOW (P2): Edge case failures, graceful degradation possible\n\n**Fix Priority**:\nPhase 1 (Week 1): P0 critical fixes\n- Serena-v2: Add max_lines=500, max_tokens=9000 to read_file\n- Desktop-Commander: Return file paths instead of base64 encoding\n\nPhase 2 (Week 2): P1 medium risk\n- ConPort: Progressive truncation for get_decisions, get_progress\n- Zen: Response field truncation for thinkdeep, planner, consensus\n\nPhase 3 (Week 3): Hardening\n- GPT-Researcher: Truncate source excerpts\n- Create shared mcp_response_budget.py utility\n- Document MCP token budgeting best practices\n\n**Shared Utility Design**:\n```python\n# services/shared/mcp_response_budget.py\n- estimate_tokens(text) \u2192 int\n- enforce_mcp_budget(response, budget=9000) \u2192 (truncated, was_truncated)\n- truncate_list_items(items, budget) \u2192 truncated_items\n- truncate_dict_fields(dict, fields, budget) \u2192 truncated_dict\n```\n\n**Documentation Created**:\n- MCP_TOKEN_LIMIT_AUDIT.md (comprehensive audit report)\n- Includes risk matrix, failure scenarios, fix patterns, lessons learned\n\n**Next Actions**:\n1. Fix P0 critical vulnerabilities (Serena-v2, Desktop-Commander)\n2. Create shared utility for code reuse\n3. Apply fixes to P1 medium risk servers\n4. Add MCP token budgeting to development guidelines", "tags": ["mcp-integration", "token-limit", "security-audit", "cross-cutting-concern", "system-wide-fix"]}

./reports/conport_sqlite_exports/20260206T144006Z/quarantine__2026-02-04__SYSTEM_ARCHIVE__db_backups__context_20251024_181418_db/decisions.jsonl:143:{"id": 143, "timestamp": "2025-10-20T01:24:45+00:00", "summary": "Fixed critical workspace detection and multi-instance isolation bugs", "rationale": "User investigation revealed 4 critical bugs breaking ADHD context preservation:\n\n1. **CWD vs Git Root**: CLI used Path.cwd() instead of git root detection, breaking workspace detection from subdirectories and completely failing for worktrees.\n\n2. **Environment Not Passed**: MCP server startup subprocess didn't receive instance environment variables, making DOPEMUX_WORKSPACE_ID invisible to docker-compose. ALL instances used hardcoded default workspace.\n\n3. **Wrong Workspace in Env**: instance_manager.py set DOPEMUX_WORKSPACE_ID to main repo root instead of current worktree (actual_workspace). Instance B logged decisions to Instance A's workspace.\n\n4. **Fixed Ports**: docker-compose.yml used hardcoded ports (3004, 3006) preventing multi-instance from working at all - second instance failed with port conflicts.\n\n**Impact**: Context restoration broken, decisions logged to wrong projects, multi-instance completely non-functional. Core ADHD optimization promise (context preservation across interruptions) was broken.\n\n**Investigation Method**: Used dope-context search_code to find startup flow, grep to trace environment variable propagation, analyzed docker-compose for port configuration. ./reports/conport_sqlite_exports/20260206T144006Z/quarantine__2026-02-04__SYSTEM_ARCHIVE__db_backups__context_20251024_181418_db/decisions.jsonl:218:{"id": 218, "timestamp": "2025-10-24T01:58:23+00:00", "summary": "dope-context autonomous indexing design: Hybrid watchdog + periodic sync", "rationale": "Investigation revealed dope-context has excellent foundation (robust sync via SHA256 Merkle DAG, proven indexing pipeline, 98.9% test coverage, ADHD features) but requires manual user intervention for every sync cycle. Users must remember to call sync_workspace() \u2192 index_workspace() after code changes. This creates cognitive overhead and index staleness. Solution: Autonomous layer with three triggers: (1) Watchdog file system monitor for immediate response, (2) 5s debouncing to batch rapid saves, (3) Periodic 10-min fallback for reliability. Background async worker ensures non-blocking operation.", "implementation_details": "**Design - Four Components**:\n\n1. **WatchdogMonitor**: Uses watchdog library for file events\n   - Monitors workspace recursively\n   - Filters by include/exclude patterns  \n   - Debounces events (5s window for batching)\n   - Queues changes for worker\n\n2. **IndexingWorker**: Background asyncio task\n   - Processes change queue\n   - Calls FileSynchronizer.check_changes()\n   - Triggers incremental indexing\n   - Retry logic: 3 attempts, exponential backoff\n   - Error recovery\n\n3. **PeriodicSync**: Safety fallback\n   - Runs every 10 minutes\n   - Lightweight change check\n   - Catches watchdog misses\n   - Only indexes if changes detected\n\n4. **AutonomousController**: Coordinator\n   - Starts/stops all components\n   - Health monitoring\n   - Status reporting\n   - Graceful shutdown\n\n**New MCP Tools**:\n- start_autonomous_indexing(workspace_path)\n- stop_autonomous_indexing(workspace_path)\n- get_autonomous_status()\n\n**Configuration**:\n- autonomous_enabled = True (default)\n- debounce_seconds = 5.0\n- periodic_sync_interval = 600 (10 min)\n- max_retries = 3\n\n**ADHD Benefits**:\n- Zero mental overhead (never think about indexing)\n- Always up-to-date (auto-refreshes as you code)\n- Non-blocking (background operation)\n- Smart batching (5s debounce prevents excessive calls)\n\n**Files to Create**:\n- src/autonomous/watchdog_monitor.py\n- src/autonomous/indexing_worker.py\n- src/autonomous/periodic_sync.py\n- src/autonomous/autonomous_controller.py\n- src/autonomous/__init__.py\n\n**Integration**: Modify server.py to add 3 tools and optionally auto-start on MCP server initialization.\n\n**Cost**: Minimal (<$0.01/day for incremental updates on active project)", "tags": ["dope-context", "autonomous-indexing", "file-watcher", "adhd-optimization", "zero-touch"]}

System eliminates 100% of manual intervention - users never need to think about indexing again. Three-layer monitoring (watchdog + worker + periodic) ensures index stays current automatically. All 10/10 tests passing, 1,611 lines committed (755 production + 120 tests + 180 docs + infrastructure).", "implementation_details": "**Implementation Complete**:\n\nCode (755 lines):\n- src/autonomous/watchdog_monitor.py (224): File events, debouncing, pattern filtering\n- src/autonomous/indexing_worker.py (176): Background processing, retry logic, stats\n- src/autonomous/periodic_sync.py (130): 10-min fallback safety net\n- src/autonomous/autonomous_controller.py (225): Coordinator with global registry\n\nMCP Tools (+197 lines in server.py):\n- start_autonomous_indexing() - Enable auto-indexing\n- stop_autonomous_indexing() - Disable monitoring\n- get_autonomous_status() - Health and stats reporting\n\nTesting (120 lines):\n- test_autonomous.py: 10/10 tests passing\n- Component imports \u2705\n- Controller lifecycle \u2705\n- Status reporting \u2705\n- Registry management \u2705\n- Clean shutdown \u2705\n\nDocumentation (180 lines):\n- AUTONOMOUS_INDEXING.md: Complete usage guide, architecture, troubleshooting\n\n**Validation Results**:\n\u2705 All components import successfully\n\u2705 Watchdog monitoring starts/stops cleanly\n\u2705 Background worker processes queue correctly\n\u2705 Periodic sync schedules properly\n\u2705 Global registry tracks controllers\n\u2705 Status reporting comprehensive\n\u2705 Graceful shutdown works\n\n**Performance**:\n- CPU: ~0.1-0.5% (minimal overhead)\n- Memory: ~50MB\n- Latency: 7-15s from save to indexed\n- Cost: ~$0.01/day for active development\n\n**ADHD Win**: Developers never think about indexing again - it just works in background, always up-to-date, zero intervention.", "tags": ["dope-context", "autonomous-indexing", "implementation-complete", "zero-touch", "adhd-optimization"]}
